name: Ultimate King of Yamimakai
text:
'King of Yamimakai' + 1 Level 5+ Fiend Monster
All other DARK monsters you control cannot be targeted or destroyed by battle exept for 'Ultimate King of Yamimakai' Once Per Turn: You can Nomral Summon/Set 1 level 5 or 6 DARK monster without tributing in addition to your Normal Summon.
